Pumpkin Peanut Butter Spread
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups solid-pack pumpkin
1/2 cup peanut butter
2 tablespoons honey or agave nectar
1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
2 tablespoons chopped peanuts
carrot, celery sticks, ap

Preparation

1 Combine pumpkin, peanut butter, honey and cinnamon; mix well. Chill. Before serving, top with nuts. Serve with vegetable sticks and apple slices.

About


Fun to serve the spread in little individual paper cups with the fruit and vegetables in individual zip-loc bags. Easy to transport to parties.
